positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Played major role in the development of Client's first mobile application: "Wheels Mobile Assistant".  Mobile Application developed for IOS and Android platforms.  
Technologies used: Xamarin, ServiceStack, Docker, #C, Azure 

Played major role in the development of the Reimbursement Product Offering for Client.
Technologies leveraged: Angular, MSSQL, C#

Played major role in the redesign of the Driver Tax Compliance product.  Responsible for the development of the user interface. Technologies leveraged: ExtJS, MSSQL, C#.

Redesign of this product won the Sliver Stevie Award 2014 for IVR or Web Service Solution – New Version.
